_about: Mutation-test targets for this plugin. Each target names the file to mutate and
the test command that must notice a change (the modules that cover it).
Run with tools/mutator.py, or as part of tools/run_tests.sh.
min_kill_rate is the floor: below it the run fails, and a target that yields no
mutants at all fails too, so a mutation pass can never be green over nothing.
Files this repository ships but cannot meaningfully mutate here are listed under
'exempt' with a reason, which the policy check enforces.

tests: for f in tests/shell/test_windows_vm_instances.sh tests/shell/test_windows_vm_compose.sh tests/shell/test_windows_vm_launch.sh tests/shell/test_windows_vm_readiness.sh tests/shell/test_windows_vm_rdp_probe.sh tests/shell/test_install.sh; do bash "$f" >/dev/null || exit 1; done

exempt.reason: vendored engine tooling, not plugin source; it is exercised end-to-end by the mutation pass on every run. This copy carries one local patch: number mutants inside shell redirections (>&2, 2>&1) and exit codes are skipped, because they are structural idioms whose mutation no test can observe and they used to score as permanent survivors.
